source.licenseOrTerms: The official ArcGIS item describes the dataset as a public record with no restrictions on use, reproduction, or distribution and provides it as-is.

errors: The official layer establishes the 2016 election cycle but does not prove an immutable November 8 snapshot.

warnings: 4790 geographic official source units map to 4788 official geometry units without proportional allocation.

caveats: Displayed candidate votes, when eventually authorized, come only from the official Michigan SOS precinct ZIP; no GIS or secondary-source vote field is used.
266 official statistical-adjustment or absent-voter-counting-board units are retained for reconciliation and never assigned to polygons.
2 official source rows use a different source county from their unique statewide geometry parent; both identities are retained and no vote allocation is performed.
